items.title: Pay locksmith invoice for door opening
items.quote: Wir bitten um Ausgleich innerhalb einer Woche, nachdem Ihnen diese Rechnung zugegangen ist.
items.computation: The invoice itself carries no issuance/mailing date, so the exact day of 'Zugang' (receipt) cannot be verified. As a best estimate, the service was performed on 06.12.2026 (a Sunday, matching the 'Sonn- und Feiertag' surcharge on the invoice) and on-site locksmith invoices are typically handed over the same day, so this is taken as the assumed receipt/Zugang date. Under §188(2) BGB, a one-week period triggered by an event ends on the day of the following week bearing the same name as the day of the event, i.e. Sunday 13.12.2026. Since that day is a Sunday, §193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next business day, Monday 14.12.2026.

warnings: The invoice does not show its own date of issue, so the exact 'Zugang' (receipt) date that starts the one-week payment period is unknown; the due date above assumes receipt on the service date (06.12.2026) and should be verified against when the invoice was actually received.
